brief:
Israeli settlers set fire to land near Palestinian homes east of Ramallah on the outskirts of Burqa village on Wednesday, the Wafa news agency reported. The fire threatened homes in the area as flames spread across the property.

No further details were immediately available about the cause or extent of the fire, or whether any injuries or damage to homes were reported.
dek: Israeli settlers set fire to land near Ramallah in occupied West Bank Israeli settlers set fire to land located near Palestinian homes east of Ramallah, on the outskirts of the village of Burqa on Wednesday, Wafa news reported.
title: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian land near Ramallah
